description: This Java class implements a scheduled service for cleaning up outdated Kafka topics related to edge events in the Thingsboard platform. It identifies topics with a specific prefix, checks their associated last connection times, and deletes topics and consumer groups if they are expired or associated with deleted edges or tenants.

classes.name: KafkaEdgeTopicsCleanUpService
classes.description: A scheduled service that cleans up outdated Kafka topics related to edge events based on TTL and edge/tenant existence.

methods.name: cleanUp
methods.description: Main scheduled method that initiates the cleanup process by identifying relevant topics and processing each tenant's edges.

methods.name: processTenantCleanUp
methods.description: Processes cleanup for a specific tenant and its associated edges, deleting expired or orphaned topics.

methods.name: deleteTopicAndConsumerGroup
methods.description: Deletes a Kafka topic and its associated consumer group.

methods.name: isTopicExpired
methods.description: Checks if a topic is expired based on last connect time and TTL.

methods.name: extractTenantAndEdgeIds
methods.description: Extracts tenant IDs and edge IDs from topic names based on a prefix.
